On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Glenwood fell from 40 in June to 35 in October (−12.5%), and 11 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 25.5% of Port Coquitlam’s 137 houses listed.

Glenwood is the north Port Coquitlam house pocket around Glen Elementary, at 3064 Glen Drive, and it is not named as an established neighbourhood in the City's Official Community Plan (OCP) — it sits inside the north-side residential area.
Lougheed Highway forms the pocket's south boundary, and Coast Meridian Road and Lincoln Avenue are its north–south routes.
Citadel lies to the east and Riverwood beyond it, with Central Port Coquitlam to the south across Lougheed Highway.

The stock is detached houses on the north-side streets around Glen Drive, under the City's RS zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 3630: minimum lot width is 15 metres in RS1, 12 metres in RS2, 30 metres in RS3 and 9.5 metres in RS4.
Evergreen Park, at 3500 Cedar Drive, is the addressed park inside the pocket's street system.

blocks.text: Glenwood Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Port Coquitlam's small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules allow 3 to 6 units on RS lots without rezoning, depending on lot size, location and transit access.
Port Coquitlam is inside the speculation and vacancy tax taxable area, so residential owners here must declare each year.

blocks.text: Glenwood Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Evergreen Park at 3500 Cedar Drive is the pocket's addressed park, on the Cedar Drive street system west of Glen Drive.
Lougheed Highway is a hard south edge: everything south of it is a different part of the city, so a Glenwood address is by definition a north-side address.

Port Coquitlam property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5 percent penalty after July 2 and a further 5 percent after September 15, 2026, and the City's 2026 increase was 1.95 percent for the average home.
The City states it has the lowest average property taxes and utility fees in Metro Vancouver, and utilities are flat annual water and sewer fees billed separately from taxes, due March 31, 2026.
Coast Meridian Road and Lincoln Avenue run north–south through the pocket, and the Coast Meridian Overpass connects the north side to Lougheed Highway and the Mary Hill Bypass.
Lougheed Highway is the south boundary street, separating the pocket from Central Port Coquitlam.

blocks.text: Glenwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

23 houses sold in Glenwood with a median price of $1,300,000 (the middle half sold between $1,129,000 and $1,381,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $538 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 6,000 square feet.
